messages:
tess: Power outage at my place, moved to the garage under the sunroof. car battery UPS + tiny 4G router = mobile office. sending pics later.
omar: Sunroof office? pls deliver photos :camera_with_flash: 
tess: uploaded one: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T123-F444/sunroof-desk.jpg (yes duct tape is involved)
nina: Love the vibes. how's the hotspot holding up?
tess: ~9 Mbps down, 2 up, ~130ms to our region. good enough for audio-only meetings.
infra-bot: Reminder: do not attach personal routers to corporate VLANs. Contact infra for temporary VPN guidance.
omar: we should make a quick "WFH emergency kit" doc: batteries, power bank, ethernet, tape, snacks. thumbs?
tess: thumbs up. will add a one-paragraph how-to and a few photos.
nina: add: a cat containment plan. very important. :cat2:
tess: noted. also learned: secure the lantern, tape wins again. end.
